intro:
Nadiad is one of central Gujarat's better-known towns, home to the Santram Mandir, a temple that draws visitors from across the state and gives Nadiad a steady sense of activity well beyond its role as a district town. Weddings here happen with that same energy, and a baraat with a proper truck, dhol line, and full production feels right at home on Nadiad's busier streets.

Plan My Baraat handles the complete entry for Nadiad weddings as one booking: the double decker Baraat on Wheels truck, a dhol team, a vintage car or baggi for the groom's arrival, and the My Safa team turban-styling him and the full baraati group.
localArea:
Nadiad sits in Kheda district, in central Gujarat, along a well-connected stretch between Ahmedabad and Vadodara, and its roads generally handle our truck comfortably given the town's size and transport links. Venues closer to the Santram Mandir and the older town core have narrower approaches that we plan around in advance.

We cover Nadiad and the surrounding villages regularly, and given the steady footfall the temple brings, we're used to planning baraat timing around the town's naturally busier periods so everything moves smoothly.
whatsIncluded:
Every package includes the DJ truck, sound system, and a DJ artist keeping the crowd engaged as the baraat moves. Raj Tilak comes with 2 dhol and chhatri lighting. Rajwada steps up to 4 dhol and adds a teddy or gorilla performer alongside the truck. Maharaja, the package most Nadiad families choose, brings moving LED panels and lights up the groom's name for the arrival. Signature, our top package, adds a security team, timed pyro and confetti, and an upgraded American vintage car for the entrance.

The vintage car or baggi and the My Safa turban team are included in every package from Raj Tilak upward, so even the entry-level booking gives you a proper, complete arrival.
whyUs:
We're a Gujarat-based baraat planning team covering central Gujarat's Kheda district regularly, and Nadiad is one we know well, with crews comfortable navigating both temple-adjacent traffic and the quieter residential venues around town.

With one team handling the truck, dhol, car, and safa, you avoid coordinating four separate vendors yourself during a busy final week. We manage the timing so the truck's arrival, the dhol beat, and the groom's step out of the vintage car all land together at your Nadiad venue.
pricingGuidance:
Pricing for a Nadiad baraat depends on your package, dhol count, and any added effects like pyro or confetti. Raj Tilak is the most affordable way to get the complete core setup; Signature costs more because it's a genuinely bigger production, with more dhol, LED visuals, a security team, and the premium American vintage car included.

Send us your date, your venue or area in Nadiad, and a rough guest count, and we'll respond on WhatsApp with a real quote, usually within the hour, built around the specifics of your event.
planningNotes:
Wedding season runs November to February, and Nadiad can see extra visitor traffic around the temple on top of the usual town activity, so 2 to 3 weeks' notice in peak season is a sensible minimum. Outside that window, a week's notice generally works fine.

A rough headcount for the baraati group helps us plan dhol positioning and how much room the truck needs, especially for venues closer to the Santram Mandir area.
closing: Message us on WhatsApp with your wedding date, your venue in Nadiad, and an approximate baraati headcount, and we'll confirm the truck's availability along with a package recommendation, usually within the hour, tailored to your event.
